dogecoin.text:
Tesla CEO and unabashed dogecoin fan Elon Musk wants the Coinbase exchange to end its "No DOGE Allowed" policy and list the meme-based cryptocurrency.
https://t.co/h502FYaQVW
Well that didn't work. Elon's latest tweet fails to moon DOGE, but an offshoot of the meme coin sees big gains. How many shiba-based tokens can this market reasonably support? https://t.co/6WgxvFgW8r
